original_coverage_E: Ethiopia: Addis Ababa city plus Oromia North Shewa and South West Shewa zones, and Amhara North Shewa, Oromia Zone and Argobba special woreda
coverage_T: Ethiopia (Addis Ababa [entire ADM1], Oromia (North Shewa(R4), South West Shewa ADM2 only), Amhara (North Shewa(R3), Oromia Zone, Special Woreda ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Renamed; now capital + Shewa highlands (incl. Amhara North Shewa); East Shewa and West Shewa moved to seats 310 and 316.
notes: Ethiopia ADM2 = zones per geoBoundaries (2016 zone set, 74 units). Oromia Special Zone Surrounding Finfinne is not a separate ADM2 in the dataset; its population is spread over the adjacent Shewa zone polygons (estimate). Dataset names: Amhara ADM2 "Oromia" = Oromia Zone, "Special Woreda" = Argobba. Contiguous via Addis Ababa/Shewa borders.

original_coverage_E: Ethiopia: Oromia East Shewa, Arsi, West Arsi, Bale, Guji and Borena zones
coverage_T: Ethiopia (Oromia (Arsi, West Arsi, Bale, Guji, Borena, East Shewa ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Renamed from "Shewa" (Central Oromia–Shewa); now south-central/southern Oromia (Shewa highlands moved to 309/316; East Shewa kept as the Adama gateway to Arsi).
notes: Ethiopia ADM2 = zones per geoBoundaries (2016 zone set, 74 units). Guji/Borena are pre-2017 zones in the dataset. Contiguous: East Shewa borders Arsi and West Arsi. Zone split inside Oromia uses CSA zone projections as weights.

original_coverage_E: Ethiopia: Oromia East and West Hararghe, Dire Dawa, Harari and the whole Somali Region
coverage_T: Ethiopia (Somali [entire ADM1], Dire Dawa [entire ADM1], Hareri [entire ADM1], Oromia (East Harerge, West Harerge ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Somali Region moved here from seat 317 (Harar–Dire Dawa–Jijiga corridor; Somali Region borders East Hararghe); Dire Dawa and Harari added.
notes: Ethiopia ADM2 = zones per geoBoundaries (2016 zone set, 74 units). Hareri = Harari region. Somali Region has no reliable census since 2007; high uncertainty.

original_coverage_E: Ethiopia: Oromia Jimma zone and SNNPR Gurage, Silte, Hadiya, Kembata-Tembaro, Alaba, Yem, Kaffa, Sheka, Bench Maji, Dawro, Konta
coverage_T: Ethiopia (Oromia (Jimma ADM2 only), SNNPR (Gurage, Hadiya, KT, Selti, Yem, Alaba, Keffa, Sheka, Bench Maji, Dawro, Konta ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Replaces old "Western Oromia–Wollega" (Wollega moved to seat 316); now Jimma + central/south-west SNNPR zones.
notes: Ethiopia ADM2 = zones per geoBoundaries (2016 zone set, 74 units). SNNPR = pre-2020 region (now Sidama, Central, South, South West regions). Dataset names: KT = Kembata-Tembaro, Selti = Silte, Keffa = Kaffa. SNNPR zone shares from 2007-census weights, low confidence. Contiguous (Jimma borders Keffa, Hadiya, Gurage).

original_coverage_E: Ethiopia: Amhara North Gondar, Wag Hemra, North Wollo and South Wollo zones
coverage_T: Ethiopia (Amhara (North Gonder, Wag Himra, North Wollo, South Wollo ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Renamed; now includes Wollo zones; South Gondar moved to seat 314.
notes: Ethiopia ADM2 = zones per geoBoundaries (2016 zone set, 74 units). Amhara conflict (2023-) and displacement not reflected.

original_coverage_E: Ethiopia: Amhara Awi, East Gojjam, West Gojjam (incl. Bahir Dar special zone) and South Gondar zones
coverage_T: Ethiopia (Amhara (Awi/Agew, East Gojam, West Gojam, South Gonder ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: South Gondar added; North Shewa/Oromia Zone moved to seat 309 for contiguity and Shewa identity.
notes: Ethiopia ADM2 = zones per geoBoundaries (2016 zone set, 74 units). Bahir Dar Special Zone is not a separate ADM2 in the dataset (inside the West Gojam polygon; its ~0.9m is counted here).

original_coverage_E: Entire Eritrea and Djibouti plus Ethiopia Tigray and Afar regions
coverage_T: Eritrea [entire ADM0]; Djibouti [entire ADM0]; Ethiopia (Tigray [entire ADM1], Afar [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Old "other northern ADM1/ADM2 to define" resolved: none needed (Tigray + Afar + Eritrea + Djibouti already ~15.7m).
notes: Cultural link: Tigrinya (Tigray–Eritrea highlands) and Afar (Afar–Eritrea Danakil–Djibouti) peoples; all borders shared. Tigray ADM1 includes areas disputed after the 2020-22 war; war deaths/displacement uncertain. Eritrea has never had a census (UN estimate only).

original_coverage_E: Ethiopia: Benishangul-Gumuz, Gambela, and Oromia East/West/Kelem Wellega, Horo Guduru, Illubabor and West Shewa zones
coverage_T: Ethiopia (Beneshangul Gumu [entire ADM1], Gambela [entire ADM1], Oromia (West Shewa, East Wellega, West Wellega, Kelem Wellega, Horo Guduru, Ilubabor ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Merges old Western Oromia–Wollega (312) and Benishangul–Western Ethiopia (316) concepts; West Shewa and Gambela added. Short name changed from "Benishangul".
notes: Ethiopia ADM2 = zones per geoBoundaries (2016 zone set, 74 units). Dataset name for Benishangul-Gumuz is "Beneshangul Gumu". Contiguous: BG borders Wellega zones; Illubabor borders Gambela; West Shewa borders Horo Guduru/West Wellega.

original_coverage_E: Ethiopia: SNNPR Sidama, Wolayita, Gamo Gofa, Gedeo, South Omo, Segen Peoples (Konso etc.) and Basketo
coverage_T: Ethiopia (SNNPR (Sidama, Wolayita, Gamo Gofa, Gedio, South Omo, Segen Peoples', Basketo ADM2 only))
changes_vs_old: Somali Region moved to seat 311; now southern SNNPR zones only.
notes: Ethiopia ADM2 = zones per geoBoundaries (2016 zone set, 74 units). Dataset names: Gedio = Gedeo, "Segen Peoples'" = Segen (Konso, Derashe, Amaro, Burji). Sidama is a separate region since 2020 but an ADM2 of SNNPR in the dataset. Borena/Guji (Oromia) are in seat 310. Zone shares are 2007-census weights: low confidence.

original_coverage_E: Sudan: Khartoum, River Nile and Northern states
coverage_T: Sudan (Khartoum [entire ADM1], River Nile [entire ADM1], Northern [entire ADM1])
pop_flag: LOW: 12.1m vs 12.5m floor; Sudan state populations uncertain (war displacement), compact Nile-valley seat kept intact rather than splitting Gezira
changes_vs_old: Renamed from Khartoum–Central Nile: Gezira moved to seat 347; Nubia (Northern/River Nile) moved here.
notes: Sudan ADM1 = 18 states + Abyei PCA per geoBoundaries (19). Last census 2008; state shares from CBS 2018 projections scaled to WPP 2026; war (2023-) displacement not reflected. Contiguous: Khartoum borders River Nile and Northern. Cultural: Nile valley (Nubian/Ja'ali heartland).

original_coverage_E: Sudan: North, South, West and Central Darfur states
coverage_T: Sudan (North Darfur [entire ADM1], South Darfur [entire ADM1], West Darfur [entire ADM1], Central Darfur [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: East Darfur moved to seat 346 (Baggara belt, borders West Kordofan) for population balance.
notes: Sudan ADM1 = 18 states + Abyei PCA per geoBoundaries (19). Last census 2008; state shares from CBS 2018 projections scaled to WPP 2026; war (2023-) displacement not reflected. Darfur 2008 census was disputed; refugees in Chad not counted.

original_coverage_E: Sudan: North, South, West Kordofan, East Darfur, Abyei PCA, White Nile, Sennar and Blue Nile states
coverage_T: Sudan (North Kordofan [entire ADM1], South Kordofan [entire ADM1], West Kordofan [entire ADM1], East Darfur [entire ADM1], Abyei PCA [entire ADM1], White Nile [entire ADM1], Sennar [entire ADM1], Blue Nile [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Renamed from Kordofan–Eastern Sudan; adds East Darfur, White Nile, Sennar, Blue Nile; Gezira/Red Sea/Kassala/Gedaref go to 347.
notes: Sudan ADM1 = 18 states + Abyei PCA per geoBoundaries (19). Last census 2008; state shares from CBS 2018 projections scaled to WPP 2026; war (2023-) displacement not reflected. Contiguous chain: East Darfur–West Kordofan–South/North Kordofan–White Nile–Sennar–Blue Nile (checked on geometry). Abyei PCA (~0.2m, disputed with South Sudan) placed here, no sovereignty implied; its population is a guess.

original_coverage_E: Sudan: Gezira, Red Sea, Kassala and Gedaref states
coverage_T: Sudan (Gezira [entire ADM1], Red Sea [entire ADM1], Kassala [entire ADM1], Gedaref [entire ADM1])
changes_vs_old: Renamed from Nubia–Red Sea–Northern Sudan: Northern/River Nile moved to 344; Gezira + Gedaref/Kassala added.
notes: Sudan ADM1 = 18 states + Abyei PCA per geoBoundaries (19). Last census 2008; state shares from CBS 2018 projections scaled to WPP 2026; war (2023-) displacement not reflected. Contiguous: Gezira borders Gedaref; Gedaref–Kassala–Red Sea. Gezira–Gedaref is one agricultural belt.

original_coverage_E: Entire Somalia (including Somaliland as a geographic area)
notes: UN WPP 2026 total 20,305,907 rounded. No census since 1975 (UNFPA 2014 survey); IDP uncertainty. Includes Somaliland and Puntland as geographic areas; no sovereignty statement implied.

pop_flag: LOW: 12.4m vs 12.5m floor; one entire country with no neighbour that can culturally join it
notes: UN WPP 2026 total 12,436,037 rounded. Last census 2008; conflict displacement.
